entities.name: Multani
entities.description: The Maro-Sorcerer of the sentient Yavimaya forest, an avatar made of its essence who allied with Urza, taught Gerrard, and gave up his power to bring Yavimaya's defenders to Urborg.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: The sentient forest of Dominaria whose essence formed Multani.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Multani punished for destroying Argoth before allying with him against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Titania
entities.description: A nature spirit killed in the destruction of Argoth.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: The island destroyed by Urza, killing Titania.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: Heir to Urza's legacy, taught by Multani and later commander of the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A student taught by Multani.

entities.name: Rofellos
entities.description: An elf sent by Urza to train Yavimaya's inhabitants, who briefly became the forest's avatar and was taught by Multani.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: The elf Multani sensed as the perfect creature to lead Dominaria's troops.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The skyship whose hull came from Multani's Weatherseed; Multani placed his mind in it during the war.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Used the Thran Tome to have the Weatherlight reborn, giving it consciousness.

entities.name: K'rrick
entities.description: Leader of the forces besieging the Tolarian Academy, killed by Urza.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: A goddess who summoned people thought of as gods, Multani among them.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: Imprisoned in a tree by Multani to ask for help, then helped separate Multani from the rift.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Arrived in Yavimaya with Venser and Jhoira during the temporal crisis.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Arrived in Yavimaya with Teferi and Venser.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: A Pardic planeswalker who destroyed Multani's physical body and used Radha and his mask to seal the Yavimayan rift.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: Companion of Jeska whose green mana Multani restored by bonding her to the forest.

entities.name: Leshrac Nightwalker
entities.description: Whose influence twisted the visions Multani sent to Jeska.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who restored Multani to consciousness using techniques learned from Nissa Revane.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Source of the techniques Chandra used on Multani.

entities.name: Muldrotha
entities.description: An Urborg elemental, Multani's daughter, who asked him to help Yargle.

entities.name: Yargle
entities.description: A demonic frog spirit of Urborg who gorged on Phyrexians, to whom Multani bound himself to grant resistance to glistening oil.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders Multani fought during two invasions.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The front of the Phyrexian war, to which Multani moved a section of Yavimaya.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: The island where Urza killed K'rrick with Multani's energy.

entities.name: Vuel
entities.description: Started a war against his brother, which sent Multani into hiding.

entities.name: The Mending
entities.description: The event after which Multani's mind awakened sixty years later.

events.summary: Urza comes to Yavimaya for allies; Multani, knowing Urza destroyed Argoth, imprisons him in a living tree and makes him feel the land's pain.
events.quote: Multani used Yavimaya's magic to disorientate him, imprison him in a living tree, and make him feel the pain of the land

events.summary: Multani, still in Urza's mind, infuses him with energy so Urza can kill K'rrick at Tolaria.
events.quote: allowing Urza to kill K'rrick by teleporting inside of him

events.summary: Multani and Urza become allies and Yavimaya strengthens against Phyrexia.
events.quote: After this Multani and Urza became allies.

events.summary: Yavimaya recruits the elf Rofellos as a new avatar, but he cannot cope and Multani returns.
events.quote: Eventually, though, Rofellos couldn't cope with being the avatar of a living forest and Multani returned to take that place.

events.summary: When Vuel starts his war against his brother, Multani goes into hiding, leaving his students to think he is dead.
During the Phyrexian invasion Multani senses Eladamri as the perfect leader and travels across the oceans to find him.
events.quote: that creature was Eladamri who was currently saving elves in Llanowar

events.summary: Multani reunites with Gerrard and places his mind inside the Weatherlight to fight the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Multani placed his mind inside the flying ship

events.summary: At the battle of Urborg the Weatherlight is destroyed by the Primevals; Karn has it reborn with the Thran Tome, giving it a consciousness that displaces Multani.
events.quote: Karn was able to use the Thran Tome to have the ship reborn

events.summary: Multani transplants a section of Yavimaya and its defenders to Urborg, spending nearly all his power and disappearing.
events.quote: Multani transplanted a few miles of Yavimaya and several of its most powerful defenders to Urborg

events.summary: Karona summons several people thought of as gods, Multani among them.
events.quote: The goddess Karona was looking for people similar to her and summoned several people thought of as gods, Multani among them.

events.summary: During the temporal crisis a rift in Yavimaya suspends Multani; he imprisons Venser in a tree to ask for help.
events.quote: Multani imprisoned Venser in a tree in a similar manner as with Urza long ago, to ask for help.

events.summary: Multani bonds Radha to the forest, restoring her green mana, and hypnotizes Jeska.
events.quote: He also created a new bond between Radha and the forest

events.summary: Jeska awakens and blasts Multani's physical body to smithereens, then uses Radha and his mask to seal the rift, diminishing his essence.
events.quote: Jeska awakened and blasted Multani's physical body to smithereens.

events.summary: Sixty years after the Mending Multani awakens, and Chandra Nalaar restores him to consciousness.
events.quote: He was restored to consciousness by Chandra Nalaar

events.summary: Muldrotha, Multani's child, is born into Yavimaya's offshoot on Urborg.
events.quote: Multani's child Muldrotha had been born into Yavimaya's offshoot on Urborg

events.summary: At Muldrotha's plea Multani binds himself to Yargle to grant resistance to glistening oil during the new Phyrexian invasion.

relations.note: They allied against the Phyrexians after Multani's initial punishment of Urza.
relations.quote: After this Multani and Urza became allies.
Muldrotha, an Urborg elemental who was the daughter of the maro-sorcerer Multani

relations.note: Urza killed K'rrick with Multani's energy.
relations.quote: allowing Urza to kill K'rrick by teleporting inside of him
Jeska awakened and blasted Multani's physical body to smithereens.

relations.note: Multani was created from the essence of Yavimaya.
relations.quote: He was created from the essence of Yavimaya
